positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (9.9): 1.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 38 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 680 m, Farrer Park MRT about 740 m; closer than 152 of 662 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 350 m; more than 547 of 662 similar developments (the same as 73). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 243 of 662 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 420 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,070 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 580 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 760 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 890 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,190 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,300 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,510 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 393 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 52 new sales and 1,007 resales (1,059 purchases); new sales were 4.9% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,007 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 579 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,007 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,048 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.9%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
